points.quote: Create the identifier with `createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService')`, exported under the same name as the interface
The decorator `@IFooService` is applied to the parameter. By convention, services come last, after any static arguments.
`instantiationService.createInstance(MyClass, staticArg1, ...)`. The instantiation service reads the dependency metadata and resolves each service from its collection.
it is typically called at module top level in a `*.contribution.ts` or service file
